Method of Attack: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) leading to Stored Cross-Site Scripting (Stored XSS) attacks
Injecting malicious JavaScript code into website pages
Replacing HTML content with malicious code to inject rogue admin accounts, steal session cookies, or redirect users
Impacted Systems: WordPress websites using Real-Time Find and Replace plugin
Attack Vector: Exploitation of CSRF vulnerability via malicious links in comments or emails tricking admins
Plugin's lack of nonce verification in far_options_page function allowing unauthorized rule updates
